risks.risk: Exact PS4 model (Slim vs other revision) and condition of the disc drive/laser cannot be confirmed from the single back/port photo.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label showing CUH model number + a short video of booting to the home screen and inserting a disc (or showing disc read).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic PS4 console with unknown disc-drive/overall working status (worst case: not confirmed working).

risks.risk: Controller bundle may be incomplete (seller says extra pad, but only one controller is visible).
risks.proof: Photo showing both controllers side-by-side (front and back) and the full accessories laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console + one controller (worst case: no extra pad).

risks.risk: Port functionality claim (HDMI/USB/Ethernet/audio) is not test-proven.
risks.proof: Video showing HDMI output working + at least one USB device connected + (if applicable) Ethernet link test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as ports not guaranteed (worst case: assume at least one port may be faulty).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues cannot be assessed without a stress test.
risks.proof: Short gameplay/benchmark clip (10–20 minutes) with the console running, plus a photo/video of fan behavior (or system stability).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown thermals (worst case: treat as potential overheating risk).

risks.risk: Receipt/originality and non-repair claim cannot be verified remotely.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt (with sensitive details covered) and a photo of any warranty/serial label matching the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without proof of authenticity/repair history (worst case: treat as no receipt/originality unverified).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console label with CUH model number and serial (cover personal info).
Short video: power on → home screen (system menu visible).
Video showing disc drive reading (insert a disc and show it loads) OR confirm it’s digital-only with proof.
Photo showing both controllers (if claiming extra pad) and all accessories laid out.
Video testing HDMI output and at least two ports (USB + any other port shown).
Photo of the UK receipt (details covered) and ensure it matches the console serial/model.
response.reason: From photo 0, the console and one controller are visible, but the key details that determine a safe Oyo resale price (exact PS4 Slim model, confirmed working status, disc-drive health, full accessory count, and port/thermal testing) are not proven by the images.
